summary: LinkedIn forces AI writing suggestions into posts and messages, and uses your content to train generative AI models. You can opt out of AI training via a buried settings toggle, but the AI writing assistant cannot be turned off — it appears in every compose box.

steps.path: Settings & Privacy → Data Privacy → Data for Generative AI Improvement → toggle off
Optional: submit a LinkedIn Data Processing Objection Form for broader opt-out

collateral: opting out of AI training does not remove AI writing suggestions from compose boxes
the AI writing assistant has no off switch — it is always present in post and message composers
the training opt-out toggle has been reported as missing or relocated for some accounts
regionNotes: EU/UK users have stronger data protection rights under GDPR and may submit a formal objection.
whyTheyDidIt: LinkedIn sees AI-generated content as engagement fuel — more posts, more time on platform.

sources.label: LinkedIn Help — Generative AI privacy settings
Ruby Allen-Cadman — How to opt out of Generative AI Training

alternatives.name: Mastodon
alternatives.why: no AI writing assistant, no AI training on your posts, open-source
